anna_sales: FYI presales from GlacierBank. Ask: 30-day POC with Canada-only data residency: inference, logs, backups. BYOK via customer HSM (FIPS), and explicit deny for EU regions. They also want a redacted subprocessor list and ballpark delta vs hosted. Can infra/sec/legal confirm feasibility + timelines? @devon_sre @mira_security @jude_legal

devon_sre: Short: hosted public API is out for strict CA-only. Viable: Private single-region (best) or Dedicated pinned to ca-central-1 with routing deny for EU. If they refuse any cross-region failover, Private single-region is the only guaranteed path.

devon_sre: Example routing rule (human):
```
tenant_pin: ca-central-1
allowed_regions: [ca-central-1]
deny_regions: [eu-*]
failover: []  # no failover allowed
control_plane_forwarding: false  # prevents telemetry leaving region
```

mira_security: We can provide a redacted, region-filtered subprocessor list pre-NDA (cloud infra provider, logging pipeline, monitoring vendor). Full inventory requires NDA. Customer-managed HSM supported in Private; Dedicated supports managed-HSM with compliance review. KMS/HSM onboarding + attestation ~7-15 business days typically.

mira_security: Also need to confirm backup replication: snapshots are disabled for cross-region replication in Private; on Dedicated we must explicitly disable replication. Ask customer whether backups must be air-gapped.

jude_legal: We can sign a limited "no EU egress" POC amendment but must list exceptions (security alerts, legal requests, emergency patches). Need customer legal contact and NDA before detailed subproc/SOC reports.

netops: For peering we need CIDRs, ASN, bandwidth, and cert SANs. Typical interconnect lead time: 3-10 business days depending on carrier. Note: cross-region failover triggers egress charges; include in SOW.

devon_sre: Ballpark pricing for 30-day POC (very rough): Private single-region w/ BYOK/FIPS onboarding = "$30k-$40k" (includes onboarding). Dedicated pinned POC = "$15k-$22k"/mo + managed-HSM add-on "$3k-$4k"/mo + one-time peering ~$"1k-$2k". I'll produce a formal quote once we pick GPU profile & retention.

mira_security: I'll prepare a CA-filtered redacted subproc summary and partial security questionnaire answers we can share pre-NDA. Will flag any components that currently rely on multi-region control-plane services.

anna_sales: Thanks. I'll send NDA + their security contact. Please DM the formal quote and a short ops checklist I can paste into the SOW. :thumbsup:

ticket-bot: ticket-bot: Created ticket PRESALES-3421 -> ca-poc-byo-hsm, assigned infra+security+netops.
